_doc: SELF-IMPROVE-1 as data (owner, 2026-11-13). Every worker, every loop and Ultrastable itself improves continuously by one algorithm over a fixed catalogue of signals. Loaded by foundation/selfimprove.py, `python3 -m foundation selfimprove --check` (a step in checks.yml) and the executor prompt. foundation/lifecycle.py implements the failure-signal branch; selfimprove.py ranks every signal class and decides keep or revert. Prose is never the enforcement; this file and its checker are.
axiom: SELF-IMPROVE-1: Every worker improves itself by the same loop: sense signals, find the largest weighted gap, make one change with a logged prediction, measure after a fixed window, keep it only if the target moved and no guard worsened, otherwise revert and record why. A change with no prediction, a signal with no code reader, and a window with no verdict are open loops. The improver is scored by the same loop.
algorithm: SENSE: read every signal in `signals` from its source; each reading is (loop, signal, value, at). No source, no signal.
GAP: gap = max(0, target - value) / target for higher-is-better, max(0, value - target) / target for lower-is-better; targets live in the signal row.

RANK: priority = gap * weight * (1 + explore_bonus), explore_bonus = explore_c / sqrt(1 + tries of that (loop, signal) in the last window). Untried levers outrank repeated ones; a lever that did not move its metric in `window_days` is retired for `cooldown_days`.

CHOOSE: take the top candidate; with probability `explore_epsilon` take a random candidate from the top `explore_pool` instead (guards against a local optimum). One change per component at a time so effects are attributable.
PREDICT: write ev=predict to ops/improvements.jsonl: loop, signal, baseline, op, target, within_hours. No prediction, no change.
APPLY: queue one item (code-task) for the owning worker; the change ships only through the canonical path (merge on green).
VERIFY: after `window_days`, a probe the changing agent did not write re-reads the same signal and every guard.

DECIDE: keep when the target moved by at least `min_effect` and no guard worsened by more than `guard_tolerance`; otherwise file OL-REVERT with the measured numbers. A kept change raises the lever's weight by `reinforce`; a reverted one lowers it by `decay`.
RECORD: append the verdict (ev=verdict) and write the lesson to docs/lessons; the next SENSE reads it, so the loop learns which levers work for which signal.
SELF: score this loop with the same code (verdict hit rate, time to verdict, stale predictions); a stale or low-yield improver files OL-MUTATE-improve.

signals.note: share of settled changes that were kept, by origin class and actor (PROVENANCE-1); a lever whose changes keep being reverted is retired, one that is kept is reinforced
did the loop do its job; same-signature failures twice trigger a mutation
share of items ending verified, not no-change or error; each row carries its prediction
predictions that came true; a worker that cannot predict cannot improve
trigger to closing probe, in SLA multiples
open sessions past their TTL; reaps per agent
repeat failure signatures; the same failure twice is a design defect, not bad luck
silent drops, hidden failures and hand-backs lower trust; verified autonomous results raise it
known gaps with no closing item
spend per verified result against cap; a gain that breaches the cap is a regression
verified deploys per window against the criticality baseline (bootstrap to criticality)
unanswered questions, complaints and asks from real users and pilots
objective key results: reach, pilots, subscribers; the signal the world sends back

guards: cost stays under its cap (budget guard)
loop-pass-rate and executor-result never fall while another signal rises
no verification probe, guard metric, opt-out or suppression rule is weakened to make a signal move
the personal and research stores stay separate
per_worker_contract: Every worker and loop registers its own signals in the table above or in its loop-registry row, runs SENSE to RECORD on its own tick, and may change only its own component. A worker with no signal row is reported by `selfimprove --check`.
